{{Quote|Very interesting&hellip; Very interesting indeed!|Dulok scout, upon seeing the Ewok battle wagon being rebuilt|<ref name="WW" />}}
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="date">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=222689&start=1905#14621041|thread=Books, Comics, & Television VIPs|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-04-20|time=11:42 AM|quote=The 3 ABY dating (technically, it should be 3.5) is from the timeline in Behind the Magic.}}</ref> a [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] '''scout''' [[Spy/Legends|spied]] the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] constructing a [[Ewok battle wagon|battle wagon]] in the [[Tree/Legends|forest]] near [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|moon of Endor]]. The [[Scout/Legends|scout]] informed the [[King/Legends|king]] of [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Gorneesh's tribe|tribe]], [[Gorneesh/Legends|Gorneesh]], at the Duloks' headquarters in the [[Dulok Swamp]]. Suspicious of the Ewok's project, Gorneesh sent the tribe [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]], [[Umwak]], to investigate.<ref name="WW" />
